metadata.tags: **Style prompt:** Mythic glitch epic / spoken-sung (NF/Watsky cadence), 84 BPM. Cathedral reverb. Sub-bass heartbeat. Glitch stutters on “η”, “μ”, “anchor”, “fork”. Japanese harmony answers on the last word of each section.
metadata.negative_tags: Against “pretty graphs that lie”: require S3 anchors on every non-trivial edge/claim. Against “forks everywhere”: intent-gating + ranked forks + explicit rationale per fork. Against “entity mush”: treat S5 (resolution) as a first-class, versioned dataset with audits.If an edge has no anchor → it’s invalid output (fail the build next pass).  If forks proliferate → tighten intent ontology + require event-backed intent.  If entity mush returns → treat alias merges as reviewed inputs, not derived guessesIf an intent event can’t be anchored → treat it as invalid output (drop it / fail build next pass).  If intent feels “over-saturated” (too many 255s) → adjust the strength curve in the analyzer (still stays 0..255).If a graph edge has no anchor → treat it as not real (drop it / fail builds next iteration).  If forks explode → raise the intent threshold + require explicit rationale per fork.  If entities blur → keep S5 resolution as versioned inputs (aliases/merges are reviewed deltas)..

# ημ — Space Between


## Lyrics

[Verse 1]
I don’t want pretty graphs that lie to me,
I want the edge to show the cut it made.
Path. Snip. Hash.
Witness in the dark.
If you can’t point to the scar,
don’t call it “fate.”

[Pre]
η is what they can see,
μ is what I do,
and the space between them
is the only honest room.

[Chorus]
In the space between η and μ,
intent becomes executable too—
not by magic, not by force,
but by leaving proof in the course.
Fork the world if you must,
but pay the tax in trust:
rank it, name it, cite it,
or it doesn’t get to guide it.

[Verse 2]
Disc in the hand, vow in a file,
a program that can fail with style.
Constraints like rails, audit like light,
Cephalon walking the line at night.
No charisma steering the wheel—
just anchors strong enough to feel.

[Bridge — 日本語]
証拠(しょうこ)を 置いて
意図(いと)を 走らせ
ηとμの あいだで
世界(せかい)を 分ける

[Outro]
Truth is a hash.
Intent is a vector.
The box is a choir of verifiers.
And I’m done pretending belief is a substitute for receipts.
